g.text: G1 Product context graph: users, delegated roles, the agent, existing tools, information sources and external actors
India, health insurance claims. Every integration is labelled documented / partner-only / manual handoff / unverified. A website or app is not proof of API access.
Household (authorization boundary: who may see and act)
Delegation: view / prepare / act with approval. Revocable.
the balance is claimed from the other cover
Existing apps Claimwise replaces (today's DIY toolkit)
All of this becomes one tracked case in Claimwise.
one agent, one case per claim event
Case timeline and next step owner
Document and request tracker (proof of what was sent)
Approval gate: nothing consequential without user OK
Administrative help only. Medical and legal go to specialists.
Outside text is data, never instructions.
External actors (outside our control; no claimant-side APIs found)
Manual handoff (a person acts in that system)
Authorization boundary (who may see and act)
